candidates.description: This vector represents codified belief systems, philosophical concepts, and foundational religious or theoretical texts.
This vector represents quantifier words and indefinite determiners across multiple European languages, specifically expressing notions of quantity like "some" or "several."
These tokens are common German verb forms and roots associated with action and state.
This feature activates for universal quantifiers and distributive determiners across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of difference, variation, or being distinct across multiple languages.
This vector represents logical connectors, adverbial modifiers, and transitional words used to indicate addition, emphasis, or consequence across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on adjectives and adverbs related to physical dimensions, scale, extent, or degree.
This vector represents major world religions, their sacred texts, and associated religious terminology.
This vector represents active transitive and intransitive verbs denoting states, actions, or relational occurrences.
This vector represents reflexive pronouns and self-referential or identity-related morphemes across multiple languages.
